## Who holds each role here

| role | held by |
| --- | --- |
| owner | *a person* |
| design authority | *the owner threads below, each for its workstreams* |
| technical lead | *one per project or work package, for its life* |
| demand manager | *who* |
| release manager, environments manager | *who* |
| test manager, librarian | *who* |
| security | *policy: who; this application's controls: who* |

| owner thread | design authority for | kind | runs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| *name* | *workstreams from the workstream register* | *permanent, or on call* | *cloud, or local* |

*For each on-call authority: the document sections that define it, and the
skill saying what it signs off and what it defers to.*
